user-photos-2026-10-20-main.title: User photographs of parking signs on Main Street from East 5th Avenue to National Avenue
user-photos-2026-10-20-main.note: Nine photographs document the east curb of Main Street. Repeated views of the same signs are treated as one observation. Bus-lane and no-parking plates provide boundaries and schedule restrictions, not public-parking sections.

user-photos-2026-10-20-main-north.title: User photographs of parking signs on Main Street from National Avenue to Union Street
user-photos-2026-10-20-main-north.note: Nine photographs continue north along Main Street. Photos 1–6 repeatedly confirm two-hour parking from 9am to 3pm Monday–Saturday on the east curb; the no-parking plates bound the public schedule. Photo 7 marks the Union Street boundary. Photos 8–9 show paid meter 67081 on the opposite curb and are not duplicated as a line section.

osm-main-geometry-2026-10-20.title: OpenStreetMap road geometry for Main Street

vancouver-meter-67081.title: City of Vancouver parking meter record 67081
vancouver-meter-67081.note: The existing meter feed locates paid meter 67081 on the opposite curb north of Union Street; it remains represented by the meter layer rather than a duplicate photo-derived line.

geometryNote: Each line is offset onto the photographed east curb of Main Street and stops before cross-street junctions. Only photo-bounded public-parking slices are included; the unconfirmed gap between East 3rd Avenue and the National Avenue approach is intentionally unmapped. The paid meter photographed north of Union Street is on the opposite curb and remains in the meter layer.
restrictionNote: The public curb around East 5th and East 4th is one-hour parking from 9:30am to 6pm Monday–Saturday, with weekday morning no parking. From the photographed approach south of National Avenue through the blocks ending at Union Street, the east curb is two-hour parking from 9am to 3pm Monday–Saturday, with weekday no parking from 3pm to 7pm. Bus/HOV restrictions and full-time bus zones are not rendered as parking.
